name: Terrarium 100x40x40
label: Large terrarium
lead: Glass terrarium measuring 100x40x40 cm. Volume: 160.0 liters, horizontal format. Handmade in Novi Sad.

description.html: The 100x40x40 cm terrarium is the simplest model in our range that meets the minimum for an adult bearded dragon, which is a floor of 100x40 cm. Without a 3D background, the entire 40 cm depth stays free for the animal and the decor. The volume is about 160 liters.

An adult corn snake and a ball python use length above all, so a meter of floor lets them move from the warm hide to the cool one. For a bearded dragon, a basking spot under a spot lamp goes at one end, with a UVB tube along the ceiling. The front glass panels slide, so you feed and clean without lifting a lid.

Since it has no background, we cover the back and sides with film on the outside, and you choose one of 34 patterns. Anyone who wants relief inside can take the same terrarium with a 3D background. We ship it by courier throughout Serbia. Other sizes based on this model, for example a greater height, are finished in 7 to 14 days.
